QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] A Prayer Transcending Space and Time
QuestInfo.0: Now that you're on the mend from the final battle, you listen to what's been happening since then.
QuestInfo.1: Now that you're on the mend from the final battle, you listen to what's been happening since then.
QuestInfo.2: When Zipangu was reborn after ceasing to exist, the Acacia Chronicles vanished, and Zipangu was freed from that bitter restraint. Dunas and Ashray are now two souls in a new world, and will be together forever. What does the future hold for Zipangu? There is no way to know now. But #p9401533# plans to work toward a brighter tomorrow.\n\n#eThe End...#n
